cover_letter_text:
Hi Portal Contractors team,

I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, and I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). Your graduate role is out on earthworks and bulk excavation sites, and that's the hands-on start I'm looking for.

I spent April 2019 to February 2020 on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge and then field engineer. I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, checked the work against the drawings and did the safety checks. The diploma then had me designing earthworks, roads and drainage in Civil 3D.

I live in Melton with my own transport, a driver's licence and a White Card. I can start two weeks after an offer, and I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Give me a call whenever suits.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
